title: Final Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive and present the correct expression for C_v as a function of temperature.

title: Partition Function
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly derive the vibrational partition function Z_vib.

title: Energy Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must accurately calculate the internal energy U from the free energy F.

title: High T Limit
description: Important Criteria: The student should describe the behavior of C_v in the high temperature limit correctly.

title: Low T Limit
description: Important Criteria: The student must explain the behavior of C_v in the low temperature limit accurately.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check and maintain consistent units throughout the derivation.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect limits in the derivation.
